question: Can suppressing odd degrees retain a persistent shape while losing information needed for its future location?
status_at_design: Finite synthetic check; no weather data or forecast training
model: Unit sphere, inviscid nondivergent barotropic vorticity equation; prescribed planetary rotation p; streamfunction -w*z + a*(x*x-y*y) + 2*b*x*y
controls: same initial even spectrum, different future even spectrum
same shape power for both trajectories
wrong phase speed obtained by dropping w
nonzero odd tendency generated from degrees two and four
original finite quadrature compared with actual native evaluation
native_boundary: Existing Rust driver compiles and checks GraftFrames and evaluates Real arithmetic. Symbolic PDE identities, integration, coordinate matrices and trajectory parameters are external references.
acceptance: Exact symbolic PDE residual is zero; wrong-speed residual is nonzero; finite native values agree with rational references to 1e-12; target-dependent loss and retained invariant are both witnessed.
residuals: dimensionless time is not a month
single harmonic family is not general atmospheric closure
finite quadrature is not a converged spherical transform
a native structural certificate does not prove the PDE interpretation
the same author supplies symbolic and native formulations
